title: MCAdminGUI
description: A Minecraft Paper plugin that makes a chest-based admin GUI.
body:
# MCGuiMap

A Minecraft plugin that provides an admin chest GUI for server management. Admins can view player locations, see a map of the server, and control players.           Compatible with Geyser for Bedrock clients.

## Features

- **View Players**: See online players and teleport to them.
- **View Map**: Recieve a pre-made map for the admin's position.
- **Control Players**: Change gamemode, kick, ban and clear the inventory of online players.


## Installation
Just download the plugin on Modrinth and install it onto your server.

## Usage

- Use `/adminmap` command (requires `mcguimap.admin` permission, default for ops).
- Opens a GUI menu with options for each feature.

## Compatibility

- Works with Spigot/Paper 1.21+
- Compatible with Geyser for Bedrock Edition clients.

## Development

- Requires Java 21
- Uses Maven for build management
